Archival Dispatch: 32 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Voices of History, Ethel and Albert, Sleepy Joe, Jimmy Wakely, and Frontier Town

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Florence Nightingale, Charge of the Light Brigade, Howard Carter, King Tut, Arthur Conan Doyle, Robert Oppenheimer, Ethel and Albert, Peg Lynch, Jimmy Wakely, Sleepy Joe, Frontier Town, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 60 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 60 marks a monumental milestone with 32 canonical broadcasts dated and indexed, spanning foundational 19th-century audio cylinders and historic speeches (including the earliest recorded voices of Florence Nightingale, the Bugler of the Charge of the Light Brigade, Howard Carter recounting King Tutankhamun's tomb discovery, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, and J. Robert Oppenheimer's atomic reflection), 6 domestic comedy gems from Peg Lynch's Ethel and Albert (NBC Monitor, 1957–1958), 8 Christmas and Uncle Remus folk tales from Sleepy Joe (starring Jimmy Scribner, 1948–1949), 8 western swing variety broadcasts from The Jimmy Wakely Show (CBS/AFRS, 1953), and 4 Western frontier legal dramas from Frontier Town (starring Reed Hadley as Chad Remington, 1952).

1. Voices of History — Historical Actualities & Historic Cylinders (1890–1991)

Earliest surviving primary audio recordings in human history:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Historical Figure & Event
Florence_Nightingale_Edison_1890.mp3 "Voices of History: Florence Nightingale Phonograph Message (1890)" 1890-07-30 Edison cylinder recording of the founder of modern nursing.
Bugle_Charge_Light_Brigade_1890.mp3 "Voices of History: Martin Lanfried Bugle Charge of the Light Brigade (1890)" 1890-08-02 Trumpeter Lanfried plays the 1854 Balaclava charge on the original bugle.
Howard_Carter_King_Tut_Tomb_1936.mp3 "Voices of History: Howard Carter on the Discovery of King Tut's Tomb (1936)" 1936-05-18 The archaeologist describes breaking the seal of the golden sarcophagus.
Arthur_Conan_Doyle_Sherlock_1930.mp3 "Voices of History: Arthur Conan Doyle on Sherlock Holmes & Spiritualism (1930)" 1930-05-14 The literary creator discusses the origins of Sherlock Holmes.
Oppenheimer_Now_I_Am_Become_Death.mp3 "Voices of History: J. Robert Oppenheimer - 'Now I am become Death' (1965)" 1965-06-22 Theoretical physicist reflects on the 1945 Trinity atomic detonation.
President_Bush_Desert_Storm_Address.mp3 "Voices of History: President George H.W. Bush - Operation Desert Storm Address (1991)" 1991-01-16 Oval Office national broadcast announcing the start of Gulf War air operations.
